description: Get persisted log lines for a Depot CI job attempt, oldest first (step key/name, timestamp, line number, body). Pass job_id to read the job's latest attempt, or attempt_id for a specific one — exactly one. Pass nextPageToken back as page_token for more lines. Depot: CIService/GetJobAttemptLogs.

job_id.description: CI job id — resolves to its latest attempt.

page_token.description: Cursor from the previous response's nextPageToken. Omit for the first page.

name: depot_ci_get_job_logs
title: Get a CI job's logs
